about: What this person told voters in each campaign since 2016: their campaign website as saved by the Wayback Machine just before election day (the homepage and the pages about where they stand), as text, and their campaign-season Bluesky and Threads posts. From scripts/collect-campaign-text.mjs; the promises in it are found by step 2.
name: Susie Lee

pages.title: Susie Lee for Congress
pages.text:
CONTINUE TO SITE
## WATCH SUSIE'S LATEST AD
Susie is running to protect our democracy and our rights. She's also delivered real results for Nevada families. Watch our latest ad and chip in to help keep it on the air at this crucial time!
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately.
## SUSIE GETS IT DONE
By providing your cell phone number you consent to receive periodic campaign updates from Susie Lee for Congress. Message frequency will vary. Text HELP for help, STOP to end. Message & Data rates may apply. Privacy policy and SMS terms available at: www.susieleeforcongress.com/privacy
## A tireless community advocate for Nevada's working families
In Congress, Susie has championed common sense, bipartisan leadership that delivers results on critical issues like affordable health care, funding for public education, and support for our nation’s veterans.
## WE NEED YOUR HELP TO WIN IN 2022
Donating to Susie Lee means fighting for working class Nevadans. We need your help to make healthcare affordable, improve public education, and get the economy back on track.
## Make a donation to help elect Susie Lee.
If you've saved your information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately.
